entities.summary: Joseph Vonlanthen is a former racing driver from Switzerland. He participated in one Formula One World Championship Grand Prix, on 17 August 1975, driving a Williams. He retired with engine failure, scoring no championship points. Jo Vonlanthen was a architects & engineers from St. Ursen (b. 1942-05-31, St. Ursen). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
